title: Pod Salt Core Coffee 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pod Salt Core Coffee captures the smooth, full-bodied taste of freshly brewed coffee, combining mellow roasted bean notes with a gentle layer of creamy sweetness. This rich yet balanced profile makes for a deeply satisfying vape that’s perfect for coffee lovers looking for a comforting flavour to enjoy throughout the day. Crafted with nicotine salts for rapid absorption and a more comfortable throat hit, this e-liquid is ideal for use with MTL (mouth-to-lung) kits including pod systems, vape pens and compact starter devices. The 50VG/50PG ratio ensures a flavour-focused vape with discreet vapour production and reliable coil performance. Available in 5mg, 11mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Pod Salt Core Nic Salts are produced in the UK and designed for vapers seeking consistency, quality and great-tasting flavours that are familiar yet wildly creative.
